summary.headline: Astrological Lots and Theft Questions
summary.text: Continuation of an astrological treatise catalogue: entries on winds, the constitution of the universe, Hermes and Aphrodite as indicators of winds and rain, the chronokrator, agricultural lots for wheat, barley, chickpeas, and lentils, and horary questions about theft, including the thief’s appearance, location, name, and the stolen goods.
